text:
maria: quick flag  int4 onboarding for reranker-v2 showing weird top1 flips. overall NDCG@10 down ~0.9pp on curated holdout, but stable on prod-mix.

maria: short numbers:
```
holdout_curated: ndcg@10 0.426 -> 0.417 (-0.9pp)
prod_mix:          ndcg@10 0.391 -> 0.392 (+0.1pp)
top1_flip_rate:    base 0.7% -> int4 3.9%
```

kevin: do we have per-query rel-count (density) distribution for the holdout vs prod? my hunch: curated = denser so more ties when scores quantize.

maria: yes attaching quick sketch (small table):
```
bucket    avg_rels
curated     2.8
prod_mix    1.1
```

anton: confirms score compression hypothesis. quantization can collapse small score gaps -> ties. check softmax temperature / calibration layer and tie-breaking policy in eval harness.

sam: also ensure eval harness uses the same tokenizer/truncation as online. We've tripped on subtle spm differences before.

lisa: I ran a token-diff probe: harness used spm-v1.1, prod uses spm-v1.3. differences mostly on punctuation tokens for short queries.

perf-bot: run queued: rankbench/int4-smoke #9124 started for 2812345678.

maria: re-ran small experiment:
- normalized tokenizer to spm-v1.3 across harness and candidate prep
- resampled candidate pools to fixed sizes (50, 100, 200) to remove pool-size as confound
results:
```
spm-v1.3 + pool=100 => ndcg@10 gap -0.15pp, top1_flip 1.1%
spm-v1.3 + pool=200 => ndcg@10 gap -0.05pp, top1_flip 0.9%
```

kevin: so tokenization mismatch + uneven anchor density explains most of it. good catch.

anton: next: try adding tiny temperature tweak before softmax in scoring head (temp=1.05) to see if that reduces tie frequency without retraining. can test in O(hrs).

sam: also propose a new pre-onboard check in rankbench:
- tokenizer_version must match model metadata
- anchor_density_histogram KLD < 0.1 vs prod_mix
- candidate_pool_size fixed for smoke runs
if any fail -> block int4 staging.

lisa: I can open the rankbench PR to add those checks and a short diagnostic that prints per-slice ndcg + tie-rate.

maria: action items:
- anton: temp-perturbation experiment (today)
- lisa: PR for preflight checks (this afternoon)
- sam: add deterministic resample flags to resample script and record seed in job metadata

maria: thanks all. will follow up with final numbers and a recommendation for gating int4 bringup. :white_check_mark:
